name: Klassen
description: The Class is aimed at children in their younger teens and addresses issues and dilemmas that are relevant to them but that parents or other adults usually do not think are important. It's about small and big things that create recognition with topics that range from how the friendship is put to the test when two friends fall in love with the same girl to how it feels not to be seen. The Class addresses the challenges and problems that children face in everyday life and are largely taken from the reality of high school students, the one they do not share with adults.

videos.title: Casting 2024: The test filming
videos.overview: Follow along behind the scenes during the casting of the new Klassen. There were many hopeful 12-14 year olds from all over Sweden who applied for the roles this year. Here you will see how it goes when you are tested and what you do during the very first day of test filming. Program hosts: Maxine Kvanta Lerebourg and Wilmer Franzén.

videos.title: Casting 2024: We moved on
videos.overview: Follow along behind the scenes during the casting of the new Klassen. There are now just over a hundred applicants remaining and it is now, for the first time, time to audition against others who have progressed. The question is: which 20 will make it all the way? Hosts: Maxine Kvanta Lerebourg and Wilmer Franzén.

videos.title: Casting 2024: Final casting
videos.overview: Follow along behind the scenes during the casting of the new Klassen. It's time for the final casting. Now it's decided who will get the roles in Klassen season 8. You can feel the atmosphere and the nerves are on the outside. Of course everyone wants a role in the series. Program hosts: Maxine Kvanta Lerebourg and Wilmer Franzén.

videos.title: Casting 2024: First day of filming
videos.overview: Follow along behind the camera and see what the actors do during the first day of filming. Is it nervous when lines have to be rehearsed, the microphones have to be turned on and you have to follow the instructions you get from the director? Hosts: Maxine Kvanta Lerebourg and Wilmer Franzén.

videos.overview: Snitch has taken over the school and the last issue of the school newspaper is to be published. Sam is about to move again but when he leaves school he gives Zacke a very unexpected present. What has Zacke got from Sam?

videos.title: Is It Obvious?
videos.overview: Love and Calle pretend to be enemies to hide their relationship, but when a fake fight goes a little too far, Calle doesn't think it's funny anymore. Love, on the other hand, is not ready to come out in front of the whole school.

videos.title: Can't Stand It
videos.overview: Lykke ends up in constant conflict with the new substitute who can't really see her needs. When Lykke also fails in the art lesson, everything falls apart for her. Will this be the end of Lykke's schooling?

videos.title: What's with You?
videos.overview: Svante is truant and sleeps in lessons, gambling has taken over his life. When Love tries to talk to him about the problem, Svante just gets really annoyed. How is Svante supposed to get help?

videos.title: How Could You?
videos.overview: Hugo and Jasmine can't stay away from each other, and they've started a prank at school that can't be stopped. How will this end?

videos.title: Do You Believe Me?

videos.title: Kiss Me!
videos.overview: Love does everything to hide his relationship with Calle. Calle thinks differently and wants to be open about the fact that they are in love with each other, but this paves the way for an open conflict in front of everyone.

But then it turns out that the lecture had an unexpected effect and Lykke gets help from a completely unexpected direction.

videos.overview: Fiona and Tuva have had enough of the fight between Vera and Jasmine and decide to do something about it once and for all on Vera's birthday.

videos.title: You and I
videos.overview: Tuva makes a last ditch effort to get Adrian back, but it's too late, he's in love with Gabi and has moved on.

videos.overview: It's time for the concert where Sigge is supposed to sing for Lykke, but Lykke hasn't turned up. What has happened and what will Sigge do now?

videos.overview: What happens when the old gang of girls who run everything feel threatened by the new cool kids who have just joined the class?

videos.overview: Benjamin recognizes Lea but she asks him to leave her alone. Why does she get angry and what is she hiding?

videos.overview: There are too many ball games at the sports center, and Aisha is tired of the boys just passing to each other. The girls ally and confront Gurkan. Will the boys be as tough next time?

videos.overview: Molly and Rufus are annoyed by the gang at school and have brought along a poop-smelling spray that will come in handy to disrupt them. Who will be blamed when the fire alarms go off and everyone has to leave school?

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: Vincent opens up to Tilde about his feelings for his online friend. Tilde advises him to be straightforward and honest, but will it turn out the way Vincent wants?

videos.title: I Got an A!
videos.overview: Issam and Alexander decide to use AI to write the difficult essay for their next assignment. Will the teacher discover that the boys have cheated?

videos.title: You Are the Best!
videos.overview: It's Heaven's birthday and she shows Charlie a sweater she wants, a very special one. It's an impossible present, right?

videos.title: The Kissing Professional
videos.overview: Tilde wonders what it's like to kiss. Meja, who has experience, answers many questions, but it is Molly who comes up with new ideas on how to practice. Will Molly solve the kissing riddle?

videos.title: Fake?
videos.overview: Meja and Estelle are convinced that Olivia and Nadja are the ones who stole Meja's jacket. Benjamin is upset by the false accusations and gets into an argument with Estelle. Who has taken Meja's jacket?

videos.title: Who Is the Best Looking?
videos.overview: An account pops up to vote for the prettiest girl in school and Alice is one of the candidates. Heaven is very upset and thinks it's sexist, so she turns to Joseph to help her find out who's behind it. But who is it that has started the account?

videos.title: Is It You? Part 1
videos.overview: Tilde has realized that Vincent is her online friend, but does Vincent understand how she feels?

videos.title: Puberty
videos.overview: Jack and Alexander talk about pubescent things and are annoyed with Rufus who takes offense. He tries to pretend to be in the target break and hang out with the guys while distancing himself from Molly, but is he having as much fun with the guys?

videos.title: Your Boyfriend Is Cheating on You!
videos.overview: Estelle is bothered to death by Olivia who is also dating Edvin. Estelle manipulates Edvin to find out if he still has feelings for her. He seems to and Nadja happens to see it.

videos.title: Is It You? Part 2
videos.overview: Tilde doesn't want to know about Vincent and he doesn't understand anything and is totally confused. Who is Vincent's online friend and who is he really in love with?

videos.title: How Poor!
videos.overview: Alexander's old soccer shoes are so broken that he has to tape them to play and his mother can't afford to buy new ones. Edvin, on the other hand, has a new pair of soccer shoes that haven't even hit the market yet. What will happen to Alexander when he is selected for the team?

videos.title: Revealed
videos.overview: Estelle is sad that her parents are getting divorced and confides in Lea. She says that Lea is the only one she can trust. Lea feels like a fake but doesn't dare tell her her secret. Benjamin and Lea meet after school and have a lot of fun together but then Estelle shows up with Meja and Alice and Benjamin happen to be upset.

videos.title: Never Give Up on Us!
videos.overview: Edvin and Heaven get into an argument about designer clothes and Heaven crosses the line. Edvin gets angry and decides to fight back. The power struggle is on between them and it seems that neither of them is ready to give up at first.

videos.title: Obsessed with Appearance
videos.overview: Meja persuades Aisha to try putting on make-up, but Aisha feels uncomfortable with it. When some boys in the ninth grade start whistling at her, she has had enough and becomes very angry and provoked.

videos.title: The Date
videos.overview: Molly loses a challenge to Rufus and is forced to set up a date with someone. They draw lots to decide who, and it's Nils who takes the date seriously. What does Nils say when he realizes it was all a joke?

videos.title: Owned
videos.overview: Life in a secondary school classroom. Lots of drama is promised in the new season of Klassen as two schools merge to become one. What happens to friendship, identity, hierarchies, love and social status when a bunch of new students join?

videos.title: Just Chill!!
videos.overview: Nadja has a bad day and loses it completely when Rufus accidentally rides his bike over her shirt. Nadja is furious at everything that happens around her and takes revenge on Rufus. Can all the misunderstandings be cleared up after everything that has happened between them?

videos.title: Every Other Week
videos.overview: When Molly and Charlie start talking about how hard it is to go back and forth between their divorced parents, it becomes too much for Joseph. When Nils keeps asking Joseph how he's doing, Joseph confides in him and tells him that his parents are getting a divorce.

videos.title: Pressured
videos.overview: Estelle has great difficulty writing and Tilde helps her. The new teacher Vendela points out that Estelle probably has dyslexia, but Estelle goes crazy. Can Tilde make Estelle understand that it's a common problem?

videos.title: How Did You Know?
videos.overview: Tilde wonders if Charlie and Heaven are really just friends or if there is something more between them. Heaven is surprised and wonders what the difference between friendship and love is. Charlie has noticed that Heaven has stopped eating lunch with the others in the dining hall and hardly sees her eat anything at all anymore. Is Heaven really as strong as she seems?

videos.title: Menstrual Party
videos.overview: Aisha's stomach hurts a lot and it turns out she has her period. Lea gets her a pad and new panties with Molly's help. Aisha finds it hard to talk about her period, but the others agree that it's something to celebrate.

videos.title: A Tough Day
videos.overview: Edvin wants to join the secret society, but first he has to pass the entrance exams. He's going to hang out with Molly and Rufus who, on this particular day, have decided to dress up as emos, which Edvin has to do and pretend he's doing it because he wants to. Will he ruin his chance to be elected to the society?

videos.title: Pearls Before Swine
videos.overview: It's Estelle's birthday and Edvin has bought her a lovely present. Edvin and Jack get into a fight in gym class and Jack tells Edvin that he knows Estelle is only dating him to mess with Olivia. Will Estelle get the birthday present from Edvin?

videos.title: Skins, Part 1
videos.overview: Vincent wins big when he gambles with skins and invites Tilde to a gaming fair. When he doesn't have all the money he needs, he keeps gambling and doesn't do nearly as well as before. What will Vincent's next move be?

videos.title: Skins, Part 2
videos.overview: During a class lecture on how easy it is to get caught up in gambling addiction in the world of gaming, Vincent leaves the classroom. Tilde finally understands why Vincent is behaving so strangely and what is bothering him and decides to confront him.

videos.title: No One Sees Me
videos.overview: Things have gone missing from both Meja and Estelle's bags. Alice comes down hard on Nadja and Olivia and an argument ensues. Meja and Estelle suspect Alice, but you don't steal from your friends, do you?

videos.title: Frozen Out
videos.overview: Lea has lied about who she is and Estelle, Meja and Alice treat her like air. Benjamin tries to help but only makes things worse. What will happen to Lea and Estelle's friendship?

videos.title: A Friend in Need
videos.overview: Why does Molly sit down suddenly so often? She explains to Rufus that her legs get very tired, but is that the truth?

videos.title: Stronger Alone?
videos.overview: Olivia eats a lot at school to fill up, which makes her friends suspect that something is wrong. Olivia also doesn't answer when her father tries to contact her. What is going on and what is Olivia up to?

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Heaven barely eats anything anymore and she does everything to hide it. When Charlie says she needs help, Heaven is furious. What does Charlie do when he doesn't want to let his best friend down but the secret feels so serious that he has to tell an adult anyway?

videos.title: Ashamed of Something?
videos.overview: Issam tells Josef in passing that he has a lot of hair on his chest. Josef is disturbed and tries to shave it off in the toilet. But what did Issam really mean, was there a misunderstanding between the guys?

videos.title: No More Drama!
videos.overview: Meja and Olivia have a great time together. Estelle finds Meja embarrassing when she is with Olivia and forces her to choose between her and Meja. Will this be the end of Meja and Estelle's friendship?

videos.title: Does It Bother You?
videos.overview: Edvin shows up at Heaven's climate meeting and has no idea what he's doing there. But after a while of arguing, they still manage to figure out what to do. Is it hard to hang out despite being so different?

videos.title: Simp
videos.overview: Alexander thinks Issam is a simp who chooses his girlfriend over his friends. Olivia has been invited to a party at Theo's house in the ninth grade and she can bring Meja. Meja has a hard time saying no and she disses Issam for the party.

videos.title: Jealous
videos.overview: Things are difficult between Meja and Issam, they have completely misunderstood each other. Meja thinks Issam is hitting on Alice and Issam thinks there's something going on between Meja and Theo in ninth grade. Will they be able to sort it out?

videos.title: Us Forever
videos.overview: Olivia and Nadja get into a huge fight and everyone takes Olivia's side. Benjamin suggests that they meet in a basketball duel at recess to resolve the conflict. What will happen to the girls' friendship?

videos.title: It's Hard!
videos.overview: When it's time to give a speech in Swedish, Issam storms out of the classroom, unable to speak in front of people. Out in the corridor he meets Vincent who comes up with a clever solution to Issam's problem.

videos.title: Innermost Circuit
videos.overview: Alice and Meja are hanging out with Olivia now and Estelle is ostracized, she tries to make friends with them again and has bought the same tiara to make up. But Estelle overhears the girls talking shit about her and the tiara purchase from a distance.

videos.title: The Secret Society, Part 1
videos.overview: Edvin has promised Heaven to carry out a new climate action, this time it's about jeans. Edvin wants to make a denim bonfire and Heaven panics, what if they accidentally set the whole school on fire?

videos.title: The Secret Society, Part 2
videos.overview: Edvin realizes he's been played for a fool by Heaven and leaves her with all the jeans they stole from the 9s. Heaven is devastated, how will she make things right now?

videos.title: But I Like You!
videos.overview: It's sports day and Vincent is worried that Tilde will be ashamed that he's the worst at sports. Molly and Rufus "help" him hide it all day, but is it with the desired result?

videos.title: Like Before
videos.overview: Olivia and Nadja have big plans for the class party but then they find out that they have to pay for the party themselves, they are in shock. They go to Edvin and beg for money, Alice is ashamed of their behavior and starts to be reluctant to hang out with them. Estelle, Meja and Alice end up in the same group in art class and it's very awkward, but then it turns out that they have a lot in common. Will it be like before between the girls?

videos.title: I Like Someone Else
videos.overview: Lea does everything she can to avoid Benjamin at school but she finally plucks up the courage to talk to him and they seem to find their way back to each other, but is Benjamin interested?

videos.title: The Class Party
videos.overview: Olivia and Nadja have failed to organize the party and they have also realized that Estelle and her friends have hidden the fact that there are things to borrow at school. A big fight breaks out between the rival girls. Will the class party be completely ruined and is Alice really as bad as everyone thinks?

videos.title: Are You Hanging Out?
videos.overview: Olivia and Estelle have become really close over the summer and the others in the group feel left out. Meja wants everyone to do something together after school, but the stable is more important to Estelle and Olivia. When handsome Ludwig in ninth grade shows up and is going to the beach, the stable is no longer as important to the girls.

videos.title: Even More in Love
videos.overview: Benjamin and Lea have been together for almost a year and Benjamin tells his friends that he has made a present for Lea. Naturally, the guys have some opinions about what he should buy for his girlfriend and this makes Benjamin very insecure.

videos.title: Not So Fun Anymore...
videos.overview: It's clear that Molly and Rufus are starting to grow apart. Rufus wants to hang out with the jocks and seeks attention from Jack. Molly feels them drifting further and further apart. When it's time for group work, she still takes it for granted that they will work together. Rufus doesn't think they should always be in pairs, but they go ahead anyway.

videos.title: Cringe
videos.overview: Alice, Estelle and Olivia are thrilled with the beach hangout where they've been watching Ludwig. When they meet Meja, they realize that they forgot to tell her, the girls decide in a panic to cover it all up.

videos.title: Copy Cat
videos.overview: When Aisha tells Lea how hard it is not to have a close friend, Lea comforts her and says she is hers. They even decide to hang out after school. The next day, Aisha gives a best friend necklace to Lea, who doesn't know how to react - Aisha is her friend, but not her best friend.

videos.title: Not at All Like Before
videos.overview: There is a strange atmosphere between Olivia and Nadja, they have nothing in common anymore. Molly sees that Nadja is sad and they talk about how hard it is that everything has to change just because you get older. Nadja tries to meet Olivia one-on-one, but everything is immediately ruined when Olivia drags Estelle along.

videos.title: A Best Friend
videos.overview: Aisha thinks she and Lea are best friends and is disappointed when she sees that Lea is not wearing her best friend necklace. For Aisha, who feels very lonely, it is important to have a really close friend.

videos.title: No One to Hang Out With
videos.overview: Molly doesn't know who to be with now that she and Rufus aren't hanging out anymore and in sewing class they start fighting. Molly is about to lose it completely but during a lesson she and Nadja find each other.

videos.title: The World's Finest
videos.overview: Benjamin is on his way to school and finds two five hundred Swedish krona bills, he is overjoyed, now he can skip his homemade gift and instead give Lea something really nice for their first birthday. But where does the money come from?

videos.title: Party?
videos.overview: Both Olivia and Estelle are bored and decide to throw a party, but it has to be a good one. Who should be invited, where should the party be and who should provide the drinks?

videos.title: Whose Friend
videos.overview: Vincent and Tilde have broken up but they have the same friends and it gets complicated when they have to do things together like before. What do you do when you're no longer together but your friends are the same?

videos.title: Wannabe
videos.overview: Rufus has started hanging out with Jack and his gang, Jack is popular and is also the one who gets the most girls. The only problem is that Rufus has never been with a girl or even messed around with one. Of course, he doesn't dare tell the guys that, so he tells a lie about him and Molly.

videos.title: Who Am I?
videos.overview: The class has been given the task of creating a portrait of their inner selves. Vincent and Issam have problems with the task, but in different ways, and both ask AI for help. Isn't that cheating?

videos.title: Competition for Jack
videos.overview: Alexander feels threatened by Rufus and it doesn't get any better when Jack chooses Rufus over Alexander in his team when they play basketball. Without thinking twice, Alexander snaps at Rufus and posts the picture in the school chat, but it doesn't quite have the effect he was hoping for.

videos.title: Dissed
videos.overview: There's a party in the park and it turns out that the nines are also partying there. Vincent hasn't managed to get any drinks, but Molly and Nadja have made their own mixture to fool people into thinking it's alcohol. Alice and Meja buy a bottle, from which Estelle drinks comfortably because Edvin doesn't show up. Olivia tries to pick up Ludwig but he becomes interested in someone else in the gang.

videos.title: Alice's First Kiss
videos.overview: The party continues in the park and Alice doesn't know how to handle Ludwig's unexpected interest. Estelle keeps calling and texting Edvin but he doesn't show up, Estelle is devastated. She meets Olivia who is pissed off at Ludwig and they watch Alice and Ludwig disappear together.

videos.title: Right of Withdrawal
videos.overview: Benjamin realizes that the money he found belongs to Lea. He figures out that he can return the bracelet and get the money back. He sneaks into the girls' changing room during sports and rummages through Lea's bag, but he doesn't notice anyone watching him.

videos.title: Just a Hookup
videos.overview: Alice arrives at school for the first time since the party. She is so nervous that Olivia will be mad at her because of Ludwig. Meja doesn't think it's anything to worry about, he wasn't exactly Olivia's boyfriend, but Meja is wrong, both Olivia and Estelle are furious.

videos.title: How Do You Know You're Stupid?
videos.overview: Things have completely broken down between Tilde and Vincent after he says that Josef and Nils are his friends. Tilde plays Vincent off against the guys by trying to make him jealous. Nils and Josef are trying to be nice to both of them but they are getting really tired of all the drama.

videos.title: Holiday Dreams
videos.overview: Jack, Alice, Tilde and Heaven start talking about the holidays and their luxurious trips abroad. Tilde just sits quietly and when asked what she's going to do over the holidays, she answers evasively.

videos.title: Fake Bitch
videos.overview: Estelle starts to feel sorry for Alice after Ludwig dumped her, but Olivia is still offended by what Alice did. Alice gets a cake sent to her classroom and everyone thinks it's her birthday. Is it Ludwig who sent the cake, or is it from someone else?

videos.title: High IQ
videos.overview: It's a math test, Molly hasn't passed it and Nadja lies that she didn't either, even though she got an A. Molly later realizes that Nadja has lied.

videos.title: I'm Sorry
videos.overview: Estelle and Olivia want to reconcile with Alice and Meja, but don't know how. The girls bake a cake for Alice, but trauma from the previous cake causes Alice to panic.

videos.title: An Unexpected Couple
videos.overview: No one wants Vincent on their team in PE but when Jack gets him on his team, Vincent decides to go all out and he goes all out. In chemistry class, however, everyone wants to be paired with Vincent and no one wants to be with Jack. Vincent recognizes Jack's situation and can't bear to see him in the same situation he was just in at PE.

videos.title: Have You Lost It Completely?
videos.overview: Lea tells Benjamin that the bracelet is missing and he reacts very strangely, blaming Lea for losing the gift. Lea seeks comfort from Nils and when Benjamin finds them together he becomes even angrier.

videos.title: Do You Like Him?
videos.overview: Molly notices that Alice and Joseph like each other. When asked about it, Alice doesn't want to admit it at first. Alice is unsure what the others will think, but Molly says that if they are her real friends, they will be happy for her. Alice plucks up her courage and sits down with Joseph in the café.
